Section 1: Education and Skill Development
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. We promise to establish 50 new primary health centres and 20 model higher secondary schools across all districts of Tamil Nadu within 3 years with an allocation of ₹500 crore.
2. Free laptops and digital tablets will be provided to 1,00,000 college students annually to enhance digital literacy among the youth.
3. Education is the foundation of a bright future for all children.

Section 2: Women Welfare and Social Security
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. A financial assistance of ₹1,000 per month will be transferred directly to all eligible women heads of households.
5. Maternity leave benefit will be enhanced to 12 months with full pay for state government employees.
6. Empowering women will uplift the entire state towards unmatched prosperity.

Section 3: Agriculture and Rural Infrastructure
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. We will provide 100 free electricity units to all agricultural pump sets and small farmers.
8. Construction of 500 solar-powered cold storage units near major agricultural markets with a total budget of ₹300 crore.
9. We envision a greener, happier, and more prosperous countryside for everyone.
